NOTE
**Still not ready: no linked issue, so we can't tell the work was approved**

New: The author squashed five pushes into one commit, kept the new test, and CI passes. Missing: a real "Fixes: #N" line (the description has only a sentence after "Fixes:"), and an issue labeled "help wanted" that shows the work was approved.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to link the issue this fixes; if there is none or it lacks "help wanted", this becomes a close candidate.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for cleaning up the commits and adding a test! Please link the issue this fixes with "Fixes: #N" in the description, and make sure it's labeled "help wanted" (see the [PR guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/review-process.html)); then we can take another look.
```
